about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing folks overcharged by cowboys.
about_para_1: AB Plumbing & Heating was founded on the principle that honest, reliable gas engineering shouldn't cost the earth. Over 12 years, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, fixing the problem properly, and charging fair prices. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and fully trained to handle emergencies and complex heating installations.
about_para_2: Stoke families and landlords trust us because we answer our phones, explain what's wrong in plain English, and get you back to warmth fast. We're not flashy—we're just good at what we do. Half our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals, and that's exactly how we like it.
reviews_heading: What Stoke Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called at 11pm on a Sunday because our boiler had gone. Dave was here by midnight, found a dodgy valve, and had us back on hot water in 20 minutes. Charged a fair price too. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had my old boiler replaced with a new condensing unit. The lads were tidy, explained everything, and it's running like a dream. Bills have already dropped. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Linda K.

reviews.text: Landlord insisted on a gas safety cert. AB came out, did the full inspection, no pressure selling, and gave me a certificate the same day. Professional outfit. Will use them again.
